# 反馈镇定与非定常稳态周围粘性Burgers方程的有限元误差分析

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m](Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m#L1-L19)
```matlab
function [ST,Mass,Ah2]=stima(vertices)
% area of current element 
mk=1/2*det([ones(1,3);vertices']);

% barycentic coordinates of current element
L1=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[1;0;0];
L2=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;1;0];
L3=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;0;1];

% element stiffness matrix
ST=mk*[L1(2)*L1(2)+L1(3)*L1(3) L1(2)*L2(2)+L1(3)*L2(3) L1(2)*L3(2)+L1(3)*L3(3)
      L2(2)*L1(2)+L2(3)*L1(3) L2(2)*L2(2)+L2(3)*L2(3) L2(2)*L3(2)+L2(3)*L3(3)
      L3(2)*L1(2)+L3(3)*L1(3) L3(2)*L2(2)+L3(3)*L2(3) L3(2)*L3(2)+L3(3)*L3(3)];
   
Mass=mk*[1/6 1/12 1/12;1/12 1/6 1/12;1/12 1/12 1/6]; % mass matrix

Ah2=(1/3)*mk*[L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3)
        L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3)
        L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3)];
```
$\omega > 0$

## 1. 引言

### 1.1. 模型问题

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Figure_5_NoCtrl.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Figure_5_NoCtrl.m#L68-L93)
```matlab
            M=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1)); 
            K=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A1=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A2=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Nz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Vz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));

            for j=1:size(Elem,1)
                zt=z_temp1(Elem(j,:));
                [ST,Mass,Ah1,Nh,V]=stima_all(Coord(Elem(j,:),:),zt);
                K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
                M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass;  
                A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
                [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
                A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+(ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
                Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh;
                Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh+V;
            end
%     
            %% Construction of the matricse A, B where EY'=AY+Bu, Y=(y,z)^T at FullNodes
            Awh=-eta*K(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+...
                shift*M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            G =M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh-dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Vz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            F = -( M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh...
                - dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Nz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes))*z_temp1(FreeNodes)...
                + M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)*z_temp(FreeNodes);
```
$\Omega$

$$
\begin{array}{rl} & y_{t}(x,t) + y(x,t)\mathbf{v}\cdot\nabla y(x,t) - \eta \Delta y(x,t) + \nu_{0}y(x,t) = f_{s} + u(x,t)\chi_{O}(x) \quad \text{在 } Q \text{ 中},\\ & y(x,t) = 0 \quad \text{在 } \Sigma \text{ 上}, \quad y(x,0) = y_{0}(x) \quad \text{在 } \Omega \text{ 中}, \end{array} \qquad (1.1)
$$

```matlab
function uv=ys(z)
x=z(1); y=z(2); t=z(3);
uv = x*y*(1 - x)*(1 - y);
```

#### 公式 (1.2)
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/ysxe.m](Example_1_Linear_System/ysxe.m#L1-L4)
```matlab
function [ysxv,ysyv]=ysxe(z)
x=z(1); y=z(2); t=z(3);
ysxv=(1-2*x)*y*(1-y);
ysyv=(1-2*y)*x*(1-x);
```

-\eta \Delta y_{s}(x) + y_{s}(x)\mathbf{v}\cdot\nabla y_{s}(x) + \nu_{0}y_{s}(x) = f_{s} \quad \text{在 } \Omega \text{ 中}, \quad y_{s} = 0 \quad \text{在 } \partial \Omega \text{ 上}. \qquad (1.2)
$$

#### 公式 (1.5)
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/ysxe.m](Example_1_Linear_System/ysxe.m#L1-L4)
```matlab
function [ysxv,ysyv]=ysxe(z)
x=z(1); y=z(2); t=z(3);
ysxv=(1-2*x)*y*(1-y);
ysyv=(1-2*y)*x*(1-x);
```
$$
\mathcal{A}z = \eta \Delta z - y_{s}\mathbf{v}\cdot \nabla z - \mathbf{v}\cdot \nabla y_{s}z - \nu_{0}z, \quad D(\mathcal{A}) = H^{2}(\Omega)\cap H_{0}^{1}(\Omega), \qquad (1.5)
$$

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m#L52-L71)
```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```
$\mathcal{B}\in \mathcal{L}(L^{2}(\Omega))$

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m#L52-L71)
```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

### 1.2. 文献综述

#### 公式 (1.11)
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/stima_all.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/stima_all.m#L1-L29)
说明: 文献综述中的模型未在仓库中直接实现，以下为仓库中最接近的粘性 Burgers 方程底层计算代码。
```matlab
function [ST,Mass,Ah1,Nh,V]=stima_all(vertices,z)
% area of current element 
mk=1/2*det([ones(1,3);vertices']);

% barycentic coordinates of current element
L1=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[1;0;0];
L2=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;1;0];
L3=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;0;1];

% element stiffness matrix
ST=mk*[L1(2)*L1(2)+L1(3)*L1(3) L1(2)*L2(2)+L1(3)*L2(3) L1(2)*L3(2)+L1(3)*L3(3)
       L2(2)*L1(2)+L2(3)*L1(3) L2(2)*L2(2)+L2(3)*L2(3) L2(2)*L3(2)+L2(3)*L3(3)
       L3(2)*L1(2)+L3(3)*L1(3) L3(2)*L2(2)+L3(3)*L2(3) L3(2)*L3(2)+L3(3)*L3(3)];
   
Mass=mk*[1/6 1/12 1/12;1/12 1/6 1/12;1/12 1/12 1/6]; % mass matrix

%Calculate matrix with mix term around non-zero velocity
Ah1=(1/3)*mk*[L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3)
        L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3)
        L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3)];

Nh=(z(1)*(L1(2)+L1(3))+z(2)*(L2(2)+L2(3))+z(3)*(L3(2)+L3(3)))*Mass;
%Mass=(1/3)*mk*[1 0 0;0 1 0;0 0 1];

%%%caculate Jacobian matrix
a1=L1(2)+L1(3); a2=L2(2)+L2(3); a3=L3(2)+L3(3);
b1=z(1)/6+z(2)/12+z(3)/12; b2=z(1)/12+z(2)/6+z(3)/12; b3=z(1)/12+z(2)/12+z(3)/6;

V=[a1*b1 a1*b2 a1*b3 ; a2*b1 a2*b2 a2*b3 ; a3*b1 a3*b2 a3*b3];
```
$$
\begin{array}{rl} & y_{t}(x,t) - \eta y_{xx}(x,t) + y(x,t)y_{x}(x,t) = 0 \quad \text{在 } (0,l) \text{ 中},\\ & y(0,t) = y(l,t) = 0 \quad \text{对所有 } t > 0, \quad y(x,0) = y_{0}(x) \quad \text{对所有 } x\in (0,l), \end{array} \qquad (1.11)
$$

```matlab
b1=z(1)/6+z(2)/12+z(3)/12; b2=z(1)/12+z(2)/6+z(3)/12; b3=z(1)/12+z(2)/12+z(3)/6;

V=[a1*b1 a1*b2 a1*b3 ; a2*b1 a2*b2 a2*b3 ; a3*b1 a3*b2 a3*b3];
```

A_{h}^{*}P_{h} + P_{h}A_{h} - P_{h}B_{h}B_{h}^{*}P_{h} + I_{h} = 0, \quad P_{h} = P_{h}^{*}\geq 0 \quad \text{在 } H_{h} \text{ 上}, \qquad (1.13)
$$

## 2. 预备知识

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/Norm.m](Example_1_Linear_System/Norm.m#L1-L25)
```matlab
function L2e=Norm(Coord, Elem, uh)

L2e=0; 

for j=1:size(Elem,1),
    curnodes=Elem(j,:);
    curcoords=Coord(curnodes,:);
    Cuh=uh([curnodes,1]);
%     Cu=u([curnodes,1]);
    P1=curcoords(1,:); P2=curcoords(2,:); P3=curcoords(3,:);
    mp12=1/2*(P1+P2); mp13=1/2*(P1+P3); mp23=1/2*(P3+P2);
    cg=1/3*(P1+P2+P3);
    
    uhmp12=1/2*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(2)); uhmp13=1/2*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(3));
    uhmp23=1/2*(Cuh(3)+Cuh(2)); uhcg=1/3*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(2)+Cuh(3));
    
    mk=1/2*det([1 P1;1 P2;1 P3]);
    
    L2e=L2e+mk/60*(8*(uhmp12)^2+8*(uhmp13)^2+8*(uhmp23)^2+...
            3*(Cuh(1))^2+3*(Cuh(2))^2+3*(Cuh(3))^2+27*(uhcg)^2);

    
   end
   L2e=sqrt(L2e); 
end
```
$a,b$

```matlab
    Cuh=uh([curnodes,1]);

    P1=curcoords(1,:); P2=curcoords(2,:); P3=curcoords(3,:);
    mp12=1/2*(P1+P2); mp13=1/2*(P1+P3); mp23=1/2*(P3+P2);
    cg=1/3*(P1+P2+P3);
    
    uhmp12=1/2*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(2)); uhmp13=1/2*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(3));
    uhmp23=1/2*(Cuh(3)+Cuh(2)); uhcg=1/3*(Cuh(1)+Cuh(2)+Cuh(3));

            3*(Cuh(1))^2+3*(Cuh(2))^2+3*(Cuh(3))^2+27*(uhcg)^2);
```

## 3. 线性系统

#### 公式 (3.1)
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m](Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m#L1-L19)
```matlab
function [ST,Mass,Ah2]=stima(vertices)
% area of current element 
mk=1/2*det([ones(1,3);vertices']);

% barycentic coordinates of current element
L1=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[1;0;0];
L2=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;1;0];
L3=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;0;1];

% element stiffness matrix
ST=mk*[L1(2)*L1(2)+L1(3)*L1(3) L1(2)*L2(2)+L1(3)*L2(3) L1(2)*L3(2)+L1(3)*L3(3)
      L2(2)*L1(2)+L2(3)*L1(3) L2(2)*L2(2)+L2(3)*L2(3) L2(2)*L3(2)+L2(3)*L3(3)
      L3(2)*L1(2)+L3(3)*L1(3) L3(2)*L2(2)+L3(3)*L2(3) L3(2)*L3(2)+L3(3)*L3(3)];
   
Mass=mk*[1/6 1/12 1/12;1/12 1/6 1/12;1/12 1/12 1/6]; % mass matrix

Ah2=(1/3)*mk*[L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3)
        L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3)
        L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3)];
```
$$
\widetilde{z}^{\prime}(t) = \mathcal{A}_{\omega}\widetilde{z}(t) + \mathcal{B}\widetilde{u}(t) \quad \text{对所有 } t > 0, \quad \widetilde{z}(0) = z_{0}. \qquad (3.1)
$$

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m](Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m#L34-L49)
```matlab
% Assembly of A 
% stima is element stiffness matrices
    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Mix]=stima(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Mix; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
    end
    
    A_h=-eta*K_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+shift*M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-...
        Ah2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-Ah3(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    M_h=M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
```

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m#L52-L71)
```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```
$\mathcal{B} \in \mathcal{L}(L^{2}(\Omega))$

```matlab
A1=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
A2=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));



% Assembly of A 
% stima is element stiffness matrices
%[]
    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Ah1]=stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
    end
    
    Ah=-eta*K(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+shift*M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-...
        A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    Mh=M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    
    t=length(FreeNodes);
    [V,D]=eigs(Ah,Mh,t);
```

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m](Example_3_Stab_NonLinear_System/Main_Table_6_CtrlSubDom.m#L52-L71)
```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```
$(\mathcal{A}_{\omega}, \mathcal{B})$

代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m](Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m#L34-L49)
```matlab
% Assembly of A 
% stima is element stiffness matrices
    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Mix]=stima(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Mix; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
    end
    
    A_h=-eta*K_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+shift*M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-...
        Ah2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-Ah3(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    M_h=M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
```
$\epsilon > 0$

```matlab
A1=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
A2=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));

    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Ah1]=stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;

        A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    Mh=M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    
    t=length(FreeNodes);
    [V,D]=eigs(Ah,Mh,t);
```

```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));

        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

```matlab
% Assembly of A 
% stima is element stiffness matrices
    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Mix]=stima(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Mix; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
    end
    
    A_h=-eta*K_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+shift*M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-...
        Ah2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-Ah3(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    M_h=M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
```

$$
\langle -\mathcal{A}_{h} z_{h}, \phi_{h} \rangle = a(z_{h}, \phi_{h}) = \eta \langle \nabla z_{h}, \nabla \phi_{h} \rangle + \langle y_{s}\mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla z_{h}, \phi_{h} \rangle + \langle \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} z_{h}, \phi_{h} \rangle + \nu_{0} \langle z_{h}, \phi_{h} \rangle \qquad (3.19)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned} \langle u - u_{h}, p \rangle &= \langle u - u_{h}, (-\widehat{\nu} I - \mathcal{A})^{*} \Phi \rangle \\
&= \langle u - u_{h}, -\eta \Delta \Phi - y_{s}\mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \Phi + \nu_{0} \Phi - \widehat{\nu} \Phi \rangle \\
&= \eta \langle \nabla (u - u_{h}), \nabla \Phi \rangle + \langle y_{s}\mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla (u - u_{h}) + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} (u - u_{h}), \Phi \rangle + (\nu_{0} - \widehat{\nu}) \langle u - u_{h}, \Phi \rangle,
\end{aligned}
$$

#### 公式

```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

$$

#### 公式

```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/Err_gaussiantest.m](Example_1_Linear_System/Err_gaussiantest.m#L1-L76)
```matlab
function [L2e,H1e]=Err_gaussiantest(coord1,coord,elem,ed2el,n2ed,temp1,uh_1)
L2e_1=0; H1e_1=0; 

nt=size(elem,1);      % size of number of element in the previous refinement
ne=size(ed2el,1);     % size of number of edges in the previous refinement
marker=sparse(ne,1);   
marker(:,1)=[(size(coord,1)+1):size(coord1,1)]';
for i=1:nt,           %loop over the elements in previous refinement 
    ct=elem(i,:);     %nodes of current elements in previous refinement
    curcoords=coord(ct,:);   %coordinates of nodes of current element in previous refinement
    Cu1=temp1(ct);        % Q11 approximate solution at nodes of current elements
    
    %=================constructing the 4 triangles in current refinement from 
    %====================current element in previous refinement============
    ce=diag(n2ed(ct([2 3 1 ]),ct([3 1 2])));
    m1=marker(ce(1));  
    m2=marker(ce(2));
    m3=marker(ce(3));
    curelem=zeros(4,3);
    curelem(1,:)=[m1 m2 m3];
    curelem(2,:)=[ct(1) m3 m2]; 
    curelem(3,:)=[ct(2) m1 m3]; 
    curelem(4,:)=[ct(3) m2 m1];
for j=1:4                                      %loop over those 4 triangles
       cur_nodes=curelem(j,:);                 % nodes of that triangle in current refinement
       cord_curelem =coord1(cur_nodes,:);%coordinates of nodes of that triangle in current refinement
       p1=cord_curelem(1,:); p2=cord_curelem(2,:); p3=cord_curelem(3,:);
    
       x1 = p1(1); y1 = p1(2);
       x2 = p2(1); y2 = p2(2);
       x3 = p3(1); y3 = p3(2);
       xw = TriGaussPoints(5);                % Gauss quadrature points             
       Area = abs(x1*(y2-y3)+x2*(y3-y1)+x3*(y1-y2))/2;
       NP=length(xw(:,1));
       z1 = 0; 
                                  % evaluated at Gauss quadrature points
for k = 1:NP                      % loop over quadrature points
     x = x1*(1-xw(k,1)-xw(k,2))+x2*xw(k,1)+x3*xw(k,2);
     y = y1*(1-xw(k,1)-xw(k,2))+y2*xw(k,1)+y3*xw(k,2);

    cord = [x y];
 z1 = z1 + (temp_curcg(cord,Cu1,curcoords)-temp_curcg(cord,uh_1(cur_nodes),cord_curelem))^2*xw(k,3);
end
  
  L2e_1 = L2e_1 + Area*z1;         %L2e_1 is L2 error corresponding to first component Q11
end
    
    
   P1=curcoords(1,:); P2=curcoords(2,:); P3=curcoords(3,:);
    mp12=1/2*(P1+P2); mp13=1/2*(P1+P3); mp23=1/2*(P3+P2);

    mp12_nodes=find(coord1(:,1)==mp12(1,1) & coord1(:,2)==mp12(1,2));
    mp13_nodes=find(coord1(:,1)==mp13(1,1) & coord1(:,2)==mp13(1,2));
    mp23_nodes=find(coord1(:,1)==mp23(1,1) & coord1(:,2)==mp23(1,2));

    mk=1/2*det([1 P1;1 P2;1 P3]);   % mk is area of triangle
      L1=[1 mp12;1 mp23;1 mp13]\[1 0 0]'; %barycentric coordinates corresponding to triangle in current refinement
      L2=[1 mp12;1 mp23;1 mp13]\[0 1 0]';
      L3=[1 mp12;1 mp23;1 mp13]\[0 0 1]';
      
    uxh1=uh_1(mp12_nodes)*L1(2)+uh_1(mp23_nodes)*L2(2)+uh_1(mp13_nodes)*L3(2);
    uyh1=uh_1(mp12_nodes)*L1(3)+uh_1(mp23_nodes)*L2(3)+uh_1(mp13_nodes)*L3(3);
    
    
    % barycentric coordinates corresponding to triangle in previous refinement
      L1=[1 P1;1 P2;1 P3]\[1 0 0]';
      L2=[1 P1;1 P2;1 P3]\[0 1 0]';
      L3=[1 P1;1 P2;1 P3]\[0 0 1]';
      
    temp1xh1=Cu1(1)*L1(2)+Cu1(2)*L2(2)+Cu1(3)*L3(2);
    temp1yh1=Cu1(1)*L1(3)+Cu1(2)*L2(3)+Cu1(3)*L3(3);
    
    H1e_1=H1e_1+mk*(temp1xh1-uxh1)^2+mk*(temp1yh1-uyh1)^2;
   
end
 L2e=sqrt(L2e_1); H1e=sqrt(H1e_1);
```
$$
\operatorname{err}_{L^{2}}(\widetilde{z}_{h_{i}}) = \| \widetilde{z}_{h_{i+1}} - \widetilde{z}_{h_{i}} \|, \quad \operatorname{err}_{H^{1}}(\widetilde{z}_{h_{i}}) = \| \widetilde{z}_{h_{i+1}} - \widetilde{z}_{h_{i}} \|_{H^{1}(\Omega)}, \quad \operatorname{err}_{L^{2}}(\widetilde{u}_{h_{i}}) = \| \widetilde{u}_{h_{i+1}} - \widetilde{u}_{h_{i}} \|.
$$

```matlab
            M=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1)); 
            K=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A1=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A2=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Nz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Vz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));

            for j=1:size(Elem,1)
                zt=z_temp1(Elem(j,:));
                [ST,Mass,Ah1,Nh,V]=stima_all(Coord(Elem(j,:),:),zt);
                K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
                M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass;  
                A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
                [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
                A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+(ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
                Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh;
                Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh+V;
            end
%     
            %% Construction of the matricse A, B where EY'=AY+Bu, Y=(y,z)^T at FullNodes
            Awh=-eta*K(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+...
                shift*M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            G =M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh-dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Vz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            F = -( M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh...
                - dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Nz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes))*z_temp1(FreeNodes)...
                + M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)*z_temp(FreeNodes);
```

```matlab
                K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
                M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass;  
                A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
                [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
                A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+(ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
                Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh;
                Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh+V;
            end
%     
            %% Construction of the matricse A, B where EY'=AY+Bu, Y=(y,z)^T at FullNodes
            Awh=-eta*K(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+...
                shift*M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            G =M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh-dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Vz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            F = -( M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh...
                - dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Nz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes))*z_temp1(FreeNodes)...
                + M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)*z_temp(FreeNodes);
```
$(\mathcal{A}_2)$

#### 公式 (4.13)

$$
\begin{aligned} & \mathfrak{z}_{t}(\cdot, t) - \eta \Delta \mathfrak{z}(\cdot, t) + y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \mathfrak{z}(\cdot, t) + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} \mathfrak{z}(\cdot, t) + (\nu_{0} - \omega) \mathfrak{z}(\cdot, t) \\
& \qquad = -\mathcal{B} \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P} \mathfrak{z}(\cdot, t) + g(\psi^{1})(\cdot, t) - g(\psi^{2})(\cdot, t) \quad \text{在 } Q \text{ 中}, \\
& \mathfrak{z}(x, t) = 0 \quad \text{在 } \Sigma \text{ 上}, \quad \mathfrak{z}(x, 0) = 0 \quad \text{在 } \Omega \text{ 中}. \end{aligned} \qquad (4.13)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned} \| \mathfrak{z} \|_{D} &\leq C_{1} \| g(\psi^{1}) - g(\psi^{2}) \|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; L^{2}(\Omega))} \\
&\leq C_{1} C_{2} (\| \psi^{1} \|_{D} + \| \psi^{2} \|_{D}) \| \psi^{1} - \psi^{2} \|_{D} \\
&\leq 2 C_{1} C_{2} \rho \| \psi^{1} - \psi^{2} \|_{D}. \end{aligned} \qquad (4.14)
$$

\begin{aligned} \| \Delta g(\psi^{1}) \|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; L^{2}(\Omega))}^{2} &\leq \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \Delta \psi^{1} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \psi^{1} \|^{2} dt + \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \psi^{1} \Delta (\mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \psi^{1}) \|^{2} dt \\
&\quad + 2 \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \nabla \psi^{1} \cdot \nabla (\mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \psi^{1}) \|^{2} dt \\
&\leq s_{0}^{4} |\mathbf{v}|^{2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \psi^{1} \|_{H^{3}(\Omega)}^{2} \| \psi^{1} \|_{H^{2}(\Omega)}^{2} dt + |\mathbf{v}|^{2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \psi^{1} \|_{L^{\infty}(\Omega)}^{2} \| \psi^{1} \|_{H^{3}(\Omega)}^{2} dt \\
&\quad + 2 s_{0}^{4} |\mathbf{v}|^{2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \psi^{1} \|_{H^{3}(\Omega)}^{2} \| \psi^{1} \|_{H^{2}(\Omega)}^{2} dt \\
&\leq C \| \psi^{1} \|_{L^{\infty}(0,\infty; H^{2}(\Omega))}^{2} \| \psi^{1} \|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; H^{3}(\Omega))}^{2},
\end{aligned}
$$

&\quad + |\mathbf{v}|^{2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \| \psi^{1} \|_{L^{\infty}(\Omega)}^{2} \| \nabla \psi_{t}^{1} \|^{2} dt.
\end{aligned}

```matlab
            for j=1:size(Elem,1)
```

\begin{aligned} \| \widetilde{z} \|_{\mathcal{D}} &= \| \widetilde{z}^{\psi} \|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; H^{4}(\Omega))} + \| \widetilde{z}^{\psi} \|_{L^{\infty}(0,\infty; H^{2}(\Omega))} + \| \widetilde{z}^{\psi} \|_{H^{1}(0,\infty; H^{2}(\Omega))} \\
&\leq M_{1} \left( \| g(\psi) \|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; H^{2}(\Omega))} + \left\| \frac{\partial g}{\partial t} (\psi) \right\|_{L^{2}(0,\infty; L^{2}(\Omega))} + \| z_{0} \|_{H^{3}(\Omega)} \right) \\
&\leq M_{1} M_{2} \| \psi \|_{D}^{2} + M_{1} \| z_{0} \|_{H^{3}(\Omega)}.
\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned} & \langle \widetilde{z}_{t}, \phi \rangle + \eta \langle \nabla \widetilde{z}, \nabla \phi \rangle + e^{-\omega t} \langle \widetilde{z} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle + \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z} + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle + (\nu_{0} - \omega) \langle \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle = \langle -\mathcal{B} \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P} \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle, \\
& \langle \widetilde{z}(0), \phi \rangle = \langle z_{0}, \phi \rangle \quad \text{对所有 } \phi \in H_{0}^{1}(\Omega). \end{aligned} \qquad (4.25)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned} \langle \zeta_{t}, \phi_{h} \rangle &= -\eta \langle \nabla \zeta, \nabla \phi_{h} \rangle + (\omega - \nu_{0}) \langle \zeta, \phi_{h} \rangle + \langle \Xi_{t}, \phi_{h} \rangle + e^{-\omega t} \langle (\Xi - \zeta) \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle \\
&\quad + e^{-\omega t} \langle \widetilde{z}_{h} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla (\Xi - \zeta), \phi_{h} \rangle - \omega \langle \Xi, \phi_{h} \rangle + \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla (\Xi - \zeta) + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} (\Xi - \zeta), \phi_{h} \rangle \\
&\quad + \langle (\mathcal{B} \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P} - \mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} \pi_{h}) \widetilde{z}, \phi_{h} \rangle + \langle \mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} (\pi_{h} \widetilde{z} - \widetilde{z}_{h}), \phi_{h} \rangle, \end{aligned} \qquad (4.28)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned} \frac{1}{2} \frac{d}{dt} \| \zeta \|^{2} &- \langle \Xi_{t}, \zeta \rangle - e^{-\omega t} \langle (\Xi - \zeta) \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z}, \zeta \rangle - e^{-\omega t} \langle \widetilde{z}_{h} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla (\Xi - \zeta), \zeta \rangle + \omega \langle \Xi, \zeta \rangle \\
&- \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \Xi + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} \Xi, \zeta \rangle + \langle (\mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} \pi_{h} - \mathcal{B} \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P}) \widetilde{z}, \zeta \rangle \\
&= -\eta \| \nabla \zeta \|^{2} - \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \zeta + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} \zeta, \zeta \rangle + (\omega - \nu_{0}) \| \zeta \|^{2} - \langle \mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} \zeta, \zeta \rangle \\
&= \langle (\mathcal{A}_{\omega_{h}} - \mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h}) \zeta, \zeta \rangle.
\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned} T_{6} &= |\langle (\mathcal{B}_{h} \mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} \pi_{h} - \mathcal{B} \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P}) \widetilde{z}, \zeta \rangle| \\

&\leq \| (\mathcal{B}_{h}^{*} \mathcal{P}_{h} \pi_{h} - \mathcal{B}^{*} \mathcal{P}) \widetilde{z} \| \| \zeta \| \\
&\leq C h^{2(1 - \epsilon)} \| \widetilde{z} \| \| \zeta \| \leq C_{9}(\omega_{P}) h^{4(1 - \epsilon)} \| \widetilde{z} \|^{2} + \frac{\omega_{P}}{6} \| \zeta \|^{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

```matlab
            M=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1)); 
            K=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A1=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            A2=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Nz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
            Vz=sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));

            for j=1:size(Elem,1)
                zt=z_temp1(Elem(j,:));
                [ST,Mass,Ah1,Nh,V]=stima_all(Coord(Elem(j,:),:),zt);
                K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
                M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass;  
                A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Ah1; 
                [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
                A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=A2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+(ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
                Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Nz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh;
                Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Vz(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Nh+V;
            end
%     
            %% Construction of the matricse A, B where EY'=AY+Bu, Y=(y,z)^T at FullNodes
            Awh=-eta*K(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-A2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+...
                shift*M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            G =M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh-dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Vz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
            F = -( M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-dt*Awh...
                - dt*exp(-shift*k*dt)*Nz(FreeNodes,FreeNodes))*z_temp1(FreeNodes)...
                + M(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)*z_temp(FreeNodes);
```

```matlab
    % ==================== LOCALIZED INTERIOR CONTROL ====================
    % Assemble mass matrix only over elements fully inside omega
    M_loc = sparse(size(Coord,1),size(Coord,1));
    for j = 1:size(Elem,1)
        centroid = mean(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        if centroid(1) >= 0.10 && centroid(1) <= 0.90 && ...
           centroid(2) >= 0.10 && centroid(2) <= 0.90
            [~,Mass] = stima_1(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes
    B = M_loc(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));
    [Pu, ~, ~] = care((E1\Awh), (E1\B), E1, Ru);

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

\begin{aligned} & \langle \widetilde{z}_{t}, \phi \rangle + \eta \langle \nabla \widetilde{z}, \nabla \phi \rangle + e^{-\omega t} \langle \widetilde{z} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle + \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla \widetilde{z} + \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle + (\nu_{0} - \omega) \langle \widetilde{z}, \phi \rangle = \langle \widetilde{u}, \phi \rangle, \\
& \langle \widetilde{z}(0), \phi \rangle = \langle z_{0}, \phi \rangle,
\end{aligned} \qquad (4.31)
$$

\end{aligned}
$$

```matlab
            M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) = M_loc(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:)) + Mass;
        end
    end
    % Restrict to free nodes

    % CARE (use R = I; capture only Pu to avoid name clashes)
    Ru = eye(size(B,2));

    % Feedback operator FB
    FB = Ru \ ((E1\B)' * Pu);
```

$$

### A.2. 定理3.2的证明

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m](Example_1_Linear_System/Main_Figure_3_LinVis_Stab.m#L34-L49)
```matlab
% Assembly of A 
% stima is element stiffness matrices
    for j=1:size(Elem,1)
        [ST,Mass,Mix]=stima(Coord(Elem(j,:),:));
        K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=K_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+ST;
        M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=M_1(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+Mass; 
        Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah2(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            ys([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0])*Mix; 
        [ysxev ysyev]=ysxe([sum(Coord(Elem(j,:),:))/3,0]);
        Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))=Ah3(Elem(j,:),Elem(j,:))+...
            (ysxev+ysyev)*Mass;
    end
    
    A_h=-eta*K_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)+shift*M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-...
        Ah2(FreeNodes,FreeNodes)-Ah3(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
    M_h=M_1(FreeNodes,FreeNodes);
```
$\theta_{0} \in (\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi)$

$$
\begin{aligned} \cos(\theta/2) \eta \| \nabla z \|^{2} + (\nu_{0} - \widehat{\nu} + \rho) \cos(\theta/2) \| z \|^{2} &\leq \left| \Re \left( a(z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z) + (-\widehat{\nu} + \rho e^{i\theta}) \langle z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z \rangle \right) \right| \\
&\quad + \left| \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z \rangle + \langle \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z \rangle \right| \\
&\leq \| g \| \| z \| + \left| \langle y_{s} \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z \rangle + \langle \mathbf{v} \cdot \nabla y_{s} z, e^{i\frac{\theta}{2}} z \rangle \right|.
\end{aligned}
$$

#### 公式
代码位置: [Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m](Example_1_Linear_System/stima.m#L1-L19)
```matlab
function [ST,Mass,Ah2]=stima(vertices)
% area of current element 
mk=1/2*det([ones(1,3);vertices']);

% barycentic coordinates of current element
L1=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[1;0;0];
L2=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;1;0];
L3=[ones(1,3);vertices']'\[0;0;1];

% element stiffness matrix
ST=mk*[L1(2)*L1(2)+L1(3)*L1(3) L1(2)*L2(2)+L1(3)*L2(3) L1(2)*L3(2)+L1(3)*L3(3)
      L2(2)*L1(2)+L2(3)*L1(3) L2(2)*L2(2)+L2(3)*L2(3) L2(2)*L3(2)+L2(3)*L3(3)
      L3(2)*L1(2)+L3(3)*L1(3) L3(2)*L2(2)+L3(3)*L2(3) L3(2)*L3(2)+L3(3)*L3(3)];
   
Mass=mk*[1/6 1/12 1/12;1/12 1/6 1/12;1/12 1/12 1/6]; % mass matrix

Ah2=(1/3)*mk*[L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3) L1(2)+L1(3)
        L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3) L2(2)+L2(3)
        L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3) L3(2)+L3(3)];
```
$H^1$
